_comment: SPL used to collect context for Jev. {value}/{short} are replaced with escaped entities. Data locations come from the macros jev_cloudtrail and jev_endpoint (set them in local/macros.conf). Source IP counts ignore AWS service principals and "AWS Internal" (not client addresses). readOnly from CloudTrail decides read vs change when present. GuardDuty findings come from the macro jev_guardduty.
identity: | inputlookup identity_lookup_expanded | search identity="{value}" | head 1 | eval hosts=mvfilter(match(identity,"\$$")) | eval hosts=mvmap(hosts, replace(hosts,"\$$","")) | table category bunit priority watchlist hosts
asset: | inputlookup asset_lookup_by_str | search key="{value}" OR dns="{value}" OR nt_host="{short}" | head 1 | table category priority bunit is_expected
cloud_user: search `jev_cloudtrail` userIdentity.userName="{value}" | eval ip=if(match(sourceIPAddress,"^[0-9.]+$") OR match(sourceIPAddress,"^[0-9a-fA-F:]+:[0-9a-fA-F:]*$"), sourceIPAddress, null()), svc=if(isnull(ip), sourceIPAddress, null()) | eval write=case(eventName="ConsoleLogin",0, readOnly="true",0, readOnly="false",1, match(eventName,"^(Describe|Get|List|Lookup|Search|BatchGet|Head)"),0, true(),1), iam=if(match(eventName,"^(Create|Delete|Update)(User|AccessKey|LoginProfile)"),eventName,null()) | eval grant=if(match(eventName,"^((Attach|Put)(User|Group|Role)Policy|AddUserToGroup|CreatePolicyVersion|SetDefaultPolicyVersion|UpdateAssumeRolePolicy)$"),eventName,null()), parn=coalesce('requestParameters.policyArn',""), admin_grant=if(isnotnull(grant) AND match(parn,"(AdministratorAccess|IAMFullAccess)$"),1,0), self_grant=if(isnotnull(grant) AND lower(coalesce('requestParameters.userName',""))=lower('userIdentity.userName'),1,0), mfa_on=if(match(eventName,"^(CreateVirtualMFADevice|EnableMFADevice)$"),eventName,null()), mfa_off=if(match(eventName,"^(DeactivateMFADevice|DeleteVirtualMFADevice)$"),eventName,null()) | eval mfa_w=if(isnotnull(mfa_on),1,0), mfa_for_other=if(isnotnull(mfa_on) AND isnotnull('requestParameters.userName') AND lower('requestParameters.userName')!=lower('userIdentity.userName'),1,0), login_t=if(eventName="ConsoleLogin",_time,null()), mfa_t=if(isnotnull(mfa_on),_time,null()) | eval launch=if(eventName="RunInstances",1,0) | stats count sum(launch) as launches dc(ip) as source_ips values(ip) as ip_list values(svc) as via_services dc(awsRegion) as regions sum(write) as write_calls values(iam) as iam_changes values(grant) as priv_grants max(admin_grant) as admin_grant max(self_grant) as self_grant values(mfa_on) as mfa_setup values(mfa_off) as mfa_removed sum(mfa_w) as mfa_writes max(mfa_for_other) as mfa_for_other min(login_t) as first_login min(mfa_t) as first_mfa
change_actor: search `jev_cloudtrail` eventName="{value}" | stats count by userIdentity.userName userAgent | sort - count | head 3 | rename userIdentity.userName as actor
auth_outcome: | tstats count from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.src="{value}" by Authentication.action | rename Authentication.action as action
traffic_outcome: | tstats count from datamodel=Network_Traffic where All_Traffic.src="{value}" by All_Traffic.action | rename All_Traffic.action as action
endpoint_powershell: search `jev_endpoint` host="{short}*" (process_name="powershell.exe" OR Image="*powershell.exe" OR CommandLine="*powershell*") | eval cmd=lower(coalesce(CommandLine, process, cmdline)) | stats count as total count(eval(match(cmd,"-enc|-encodedcommand|-w hidden|-w 1 |frombase64|downloadstring|iex "))) as suspicious
related_alerts: search `notable` | search ({clauses}) NOT event_id="{event_id}" | stats values(rule_name) as rules
cloud_user_baseline: search `jev_cloudtrail` userIdentity.userName="{value}" | eval ip=if(match(sourceIPAddress,"^[0-9.]+$") OR match(sourceIPAddress,"^[0-9a-fA-F:]+:[0-9a-fA-F:]*$"), sourceIPAddress, null()), svc=if(isnull(ip), sourceIPAddress, null()) | stats count values(ip) as ip_list dc(awsRegion) as regions
cloud_ip_peers: search `jev_cloudtrail` sourceIPAddress IN ({ips}) | eval who=coalesce('userIdentity.userName','userIdentity.arn'), other=if(lower(who)!="{value}",who,null()), login=if(eventName="ConsoleLogin",1,0), other_login=if(login=1,other,null()), other_mfa=if(login=1 AND 'additionalEventData.MFAUsed'="Yes",other,null()), fail=if(login=1 AND 'responseElements.ConsoleLogin'="Failure",1,0) | stats dc(other) as other_accounts dc(other_login) as other_logins dc(other_mfa) as other_mfa_logins sum(fail) as failed_logins
rollup_window: search `notable` | search ({clauses}) notable_type=notable NOT rule_name="*Risk Threshold*" NOT rule_name="*Finding Group*" | stats min(info_min_time) as e max(info_max_time) as l count
rollup_contributors: search index=risk risk_object="{value}" | stats count values(command) as commands values(source) as rules
change_window: search `notable` | search command="{value}" | stats min(info_min_time) as e max(info_max_time) as l count
cloud_user_origin: search `jev_cloudtrail` eventName IN ("CreateUser","CreateLoginProfile","AddUserToGroup","CreateAccessKey","AttachUserPolicy","PutUserPolicy") requestParameters.userName="{value}" (errorCode=success OR NOT errorCode=*) | eval actor=coalesce('userIdentity.userName', 'userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName', 'userIdentity.arn'), c_actor=if(eventName="CreateUser", actor, null()), c_type=if(eventName="CreateUser", 'userIdentity.type', null()), c_ip=if(eventName="CreateUser", sourceIPAddress, null()), ct=if(eventName="CreateUser", _time, null()) | stats min(ct) as created values(eventName) as events values(requestParameters.groupName) as groups values(requestParameters.policyArn) as policies values(requestParameters.policyName) as inline_policies values(c_actor) as actor values(c_type) as actor_type values(c_ip) as actor_ip
cloud_users_known: search `jev_cloudtrail` userIdentity.type=IAMUser | stats values(userIdentity.userName) as users
win_actor: search `jev_endpoint` (source="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="XmlWinEventLog:Security") EventCode IN (1102, 4720, 4726, 4728, 4732, 4756) | eval actor=lower(if(EventCode=1102, coalesce(user, src_user), coalesce(src_user, user))), tgt=if(EventCode!=1102, user, null()) | where actor="{value}" | stats dc(eval(if(EventCode=1102, dest, null()))) as cleared_hosts dc(eval(if(EventCode=4726, tgt, null()))) as deleted dc(eval(if(EventCode=4726, dest, null()))) as deleted_hosts values(eval(if(EventCode=4726, tgt, null()))) as deleted_users dc(eval(if(EventCode=4720, tgt, null()))) as created dc(eval(if(in(EventCode, "4728", "4732", "4756"), tgt, null()))) as group_adds values(eval(if(in(EventCode, "4728", "4732", "4756"), Group_Name, null()))) as groups
guardduty_detail: search `jev_guardduty` "{value}" | spath path=detail.type output=gd_type | where lower(gd_type)="{value}" | spath path=detail.severity output=sev | spath path=detail.service.count output=cnt | spath path=detail.service.action.portProbeAction.portProbeDetails{}.localPortDetails.port output=port | spath path=detail.service.action.portProbeAction.portProbeDetails{}.remoteIpDetails.ipAddressV4 output=rip | spath path=detail.service.action.portProbeAction.portProbeDetails{}.remoteIpDetails.organization.asnOrg output=porg | spath path=detail.service.action.awsApiCallAction.remoteIpDetails.organization.asnOrg output=aorg | spath path=detail.service.action.awsApiCallAction.remoteIpDetails.country.countryName output=acty | spath path=detail.service.action.awsApiCallAction.api output=api | stats max(sev) as sev max(cnt) as count values(port) as ports dc(rip) as remote_ips values(porg) as probe_orgs values(aorg) as api_org values(acty) as api_country values(api) as api
ip_location: | makeresults | eval ip="{value}" | iplocation ip | table Country City
ip_asn: | inputlookup asn_lookup_by_cidr | where cidrmatch(ip, "{value}") | head 1 | table autonomous_system_number autonomous_system_organization
ip_intel: | inputlookup ip_intel | where (isnull(disabled) OR NOT match(lower(disabled), "^(1|true)$")) AND (ip="{value}" OR (match(ip, "/") AND cidrmatch(ip, "{value}"))) | stats count values(threat_key) as sources values(description) as descriptions max(weight) as weight
